# traffic-mock-recorder

> Record outbound HTTP traffic through a Go RoundTripper with redaction and caps, infer path templates from what was seen and serve the result as a mock http.Handler Go module `github.com/Trysac/u255-traffic-mock-recorder`, package `trafficmockrecorder`, MIT licensed,
> Go >= 1.23, standard library only.
